skills.name: Holy Wood (神木)
skills.line: Do you really expect your prayer to be answered?
skills.description: Ninmenju attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his DEF. ;Exclusive effect :At the end of an enemy's turn, Ninmenju inflicts 1 layer of Baneful Flower on the enemy if they have less than 3 layers, or inflicts indirect damage equal to 90% of his DEF if they already have 3 layers of Baneful Flower. ;Baneful Flower (災厄の花) : :'''Debuff, Status''': The flower that's planted onto enemies. Max of 3 layers. :''(Effect icon will change based on how many layers are inflicted.)''

skills.name: Baneful Flower (灾厄花/災厄の花)
skills.line: Red is the most lethal color of all.
skills.description: At the end of Ninmenju's turn, consumes all layers of Baneful Flower on enemies, dealing indirect damage equal to 90% of his DEF for each layer consumed. ; : ;Baneful Flower (災厄の花) : :'''Debuff, Status''': The flower that's planted onto enemies. Max of 3 layers. :''(Effect icon will change based on how many layers are inflicted.)''

upgrades.text: When Baneful Flower is dispelled, his DEF is increased by 5% (lasts for 2 turns, can be dispelled).

skills.name: Baneful Root (祸根/禍根)
skills.line: A blessing or a bane? It depends solely on how you receive it.
skills.description:
Ninmenju gains Protection of Root, lasts for 3 turns.
Consumes all layers of Baneful Flower on enemies, dealing indirect damage equal to 216% of his DEF for each layer consumed. ;Protection of Root (禍根の守り) : :'''Buff, State''': Increases RES by 20%. ;Baneful Flower (災厄の花) : :'''Debuff, Status''': The flower that's planted onto enemies. Max of 3 layers. :''(Effect icon will change based on how many layers are inflicted.)''

upgrades.text: Protection of Root increases his initial DEF by 6% at the start of battle.

bio.condition: With Ninmenju clear any zone 30 times.
